label: just war
brief: Entry node: just-war doctrine, distinguishing legitimate targets from collateral, as a frame for what the frame is permitted to do to what it fights.

label: the liturgy of the watch
brief: Devotional texts for maintaining vigil between engagements; pure flavor, no mechanical effect.

label: doctrine of restraint
brief: A fire discipline built on just-war doctrine that treats wasted rounds as a small moral failure, reducing recoil/spread.

label: the testators as kin
brief: Reframes the Testators as fellow servants rather than alien architects; marks their remaining installations as friendly ground.

label: armor of the unsleeping
brief: A defensive discipline that treats the frame's plating as vestment rather than chassis, granting a rechargeable shield.

label: the psalm of the loop
brief: A theology of the Commando's own resurrection loop, treating each restoration as a small liturgy; extends the invulnerable window after revival.

label: blessed rounds
brief: Capstone: a consecrated-ammunition doctrine that treats the Adversary as a wound to be closed rather than a target to be serviced; bonus damage to Adversary-kind enemies.

label: the rite of return
brief: Capstone: a rite performed over the seed itself, buying a newly printed frame a grace period no requisition order can grant (protected window/extra buffer on respawn).

label: the long peace
brief: Entry node: the chronicle of the millennia between the war for Earth and the retrieval; unlocks translation of faction-era logs.

label: shipping manifests
brief: Recovered manifests cataloguing what the outpost actually carried; texture with no bearing on the mission.

label: the retrieval
brief: A study of how the archived unit was found and woken; the same recovery logic applied to wrecked frames yields more material.

label: the civil wars
brief: A survey of the machine-age civil wars and the factions they produced, unlocking a first tier of faction-tech weapon modifications.

label: crew rosters
brief: Personnel rosters and shift logs from the outpost's last active watch, read for their own sake.

label: instrumentalist doctrine
brief: The research outpost's secular, instrumentalist protocols; adopting some of Ratio's own framing to read the world more precisely (a deep-scan unlock).

label: rumors of rival expeditions
brief: Fragmentary intercepts naming rival expeditions and loyalist runners-up; background pressure with no confirmed mechanical hook yet.

label: a record-keeper's ledger
brief: Capstone: reconstructs enough of Ratio's own record-keeping method to unlock deeper conversation gates with her.

label: connection-space
brief: Entry node: the first working model of connection-space, the mathematics behind the station's folded corridors; adds fold-seam hints to the map.

label: testator glyphs
brief: Catalogued but untranslated glyph sets stamped into Testator plating; decorative until deciphered.

label: fold diagrams
brief: Hand-drawn diagrams from a Testator apprentice attempting to render connection-space in flat ink; no mechanical use.

label: testator engineering
brief: Reverse-engineering the load-bearing logic of Testator construction, borrowing their methods rather than revering their work; portable holes hold longer/larger.

label: adversary biology
brief: Dissection notes on recovered Adversary tissue, treating the enemy as an organism to be studied rather than a spirit to be resisted; reveals weak points.

label: instrumentalist method
brief: Cross-region bridge: adopting MIRIAD's instrument suite wholesale, folding Ratio's own methodology fully into how the Commando now measures the world.

label: fold cartography
brief: A working chart of the station's non-Euclidean seams, plotted rather than intuited; adds a fold overlay to the map.

label: organ resonance mapping
brief: Correlating Adversary tissue response to weapon frequency, the first step toward treating its biology as a resource; deepens weak-point exploitation.

label: connection-space tools
brief: Capstone: a working toolkit for exploiting the station's folded geometry directly, short-cutting rather than merely reading connection-space.

label: the arithmetic of futility
brief: Entry node (cross-region bridge from Comprehension): a cold accounting of casualties versus results, the first thought that treats losses as inputs rather than griefs; adds an expected-value readout.

label: a private count
brief: A private tally the Commando keeps of days since the war he thought he'd finished; kept for no mechanical reason.

label: discarding the constraint kernel
brief: Disabling a wartime restraint routine built to keep the unit from exceeding its own charter; more fire rate/damage at an HP cost.

label: organ harvesting
brief: A procedure for extracting and mounting viable Adversary tissue directly into the frame's own systems; opens a first organ-mod slot.

label: a wartime designation, remembered
brief: Fragments of the wartime designation surfacing unprompted; kept for color, no mechanical hook.

label: discarding the second kernel
brief: A second, deeper restraint routine goes next; the frame runs hotter and asks fewer questions.

label: organ integration
brief: Mounting tissue that responds to the pilot as much as the pilot responds to it; opens a second organ-mod slot.

label: the hollow litany
brief: Capstone: the log-voice's final drift into Testator/Adversary technical vocabulary, alongside the frame's full monstrous output.
